# db-11 — DataBall must open many files into one session

Paths, directories, globs, recursive. Each source becomes a row in a run/source dimension (path, hash, detected type, per-source meta) joined into the `"data"` view. Schema merge by default (union by name, nulls, numeric widening; other conflicts error). The caller chooses abort-all or skip-file for bad data.
